system.description:
Favoured weapon: Scythe

Granted power: Your Turn Undead may control undead as an Evil Cleric's does. Once/day: cast Speak with Dead without a slot.

Allegiance: Neutral Evil, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Myrkul in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: gather one great soul for the Lord of Bones (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
